content.overview: Section 5 condones delay in appeals and most applications if there is sufficient cause. It does not apply to suits. It does not apply to Order XXI execution applications.
content.study: Do not file a section 5 application on a time-barred plaint. For suits, use 4, 12, 14, 17 or 18, or accept the bar. Sufficient cause is fact-specific; explain each day that matters.
